description: This file defines functions and types for processing and rendering markdown text into a custom signal format, including style merging, URL normalization, and link handling.

classes.name: SignalTextStyleRange
classes.description: Defines a range of text with a specific style.

classes.name: SignalMarkdownOptions
classes.description: Options for markdown processing, including table mode.

classes.name: SignalStyleSpan
classes.description: Represents a styled span with start and end positions.

classes.name: Insertion
classes.description: Represents an insertion point and length for text modifications.

methods.name: normalizeUrlForComparison
methods.description: Normalizes URLs for comparison by removing protocol, www, and trailing slashes.

methods.name: mapStyle
methods.description: Maps markdown styles to internal signal styles.

methods.name: mergeStyles
methods.description: Merges overlapping or adjacent style ranges into a simplified list.

methods.name: clampStyles
methods.description: Clamps style ranges to a maximum length.

methods.name: applyInsertionsToStyles
methods.description: Adjusts style spans based on text insertions.

methods.name: renderSignalText
methods.description: Converts markdown IR to formatted signal text, handling links and styles.

methods.name: markdownToSignalText
methods.description: Converts markdown string to formatted signal text.

methods.name: markdownToSignalTextChunks
methods.description: Splits markdown into chunks of formatted signal text within a size limit.
